title: AI Image to Video for Product Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Use AI image to video to add gentle motion to a product photo you already like. Download a short clip for Reels, TikTok, or your shop. Upload a shot to start.
h1: Turn a Product Photo Into Motion With AI Image to Video
lead: Turn one product photo into a short video: steam rising from a mug, light sliding across a bottle, a slow push-in on a shoe.

steps.d: Sharp, with a little space around the product and nothing crossing it.
One motion per clip, like "slow push-in" or "steam rising". Pick 6, 10 or 15 seconds.
If a label or edge shifts, ask for a simpler movement and make another.

faq.q: What kind of photo works for image to video?
faq.a: A sharp, well-lit photo with the product fully in frame. Leave some background around it, because tight crops give the camera nowhere to go.

faq.q: Can I choose how the camera moves?
faq.a: Yes. Describe one move, such as a slow push-in, a pan across the table or a gentle orbit around a bottle. Each generation can vary, so simple directions are easiest to follow.

faq.q: Will the product stay close to my photo?
faq.a: Motion can shift fine details such as label text, buttons or edges while the product moves through the scene. A simpler movement leaves fewer details changing at once.

faq.q: Can I make several clips from the same photo?
faq.a: Yes. Change the movement or clip length for each run. The editor shows the credit cost before generation.

overview.h2: Bring one product photo into motion
overview.p: Start with the photo you already use, then add one camera or scene movement. A restrained push, pour, opening or light shift gives the clip motion while leaving the item easy to recognize.

examples.lead: Ideas for bringing one product photo to life: a slow push-in, rising steam, light moving across a surface.

steps.sourceAlt: Cream ceramic mug with blue flecks on a wooden kitchen counter.
steps.prompt: Push in slowly on this speckled mug while a thin ribbon of steam rises. Keep the shape, handle and glaze as they are.

picker.title: Choose one motion for the photo
picker.lead: Each idea uses one short action, from pouring water to switching on a light.

cards.label: Coffee filter filled
cards.prompt: Lower a paper filter into the dripper, then pour hot water in one slow circle.

cards.label: Bike light switched on
cards.prompt: Clip the small light onto the handlebar, then press its switch once.

cards.label: Planter reservoir filled
cards.prompt: Add water through the planter opening, then pause as it settles into the reservoir.

cards.label: Can opened beside ice
cards.prompt: Open the sparkling water can beside an ice-filled glass, then tilt it toward the light.

cards.label: Bottle catches cool light
cards.prompt: Move slowly past the chilled bottle as fine droplets catch the window light.

cards.label: Cream pump dispenses once
cards.prompt: Press the cream pump once and show a small amount on the back of a hand.

cards.label: Balm lifted from jar
cards.prompt: Lift one small scoop of balm from the jar with a clean spatula.

cards.label: Roller glides along cheek
cards.prompt: Glide the jade roller once along the cheek in a calm, even motion.

uses.d: A 6-second clip next to your photos shows how the glaze catches the light.
A slow light sweep turns a still product shot into a post that moves.
